title: Tefaro language - Wikipedia
text: Tefaro is a Papuan language of the Indonesian province of Papua, on the eastern shore of Cenderawasih Bay. It is spoken in Demba and Tefaro villages of Waropen Regency.

text: Within the East Geelvink Bay subgroup, Baropasi is part of the Barapasi-Sauri-Kofei branch, which also includes Sauri and Kofei; this is distinct from other branches such as Demisa, Nisa, Tefaro, and Woria.
